name: Assigned To Human
description: A host is issued to this person as theirs to use: the primary user an asset inventory or device-management system records for a laptop or a phone. It is not responsibility for a server (who operates a machine is a different relationship, not built), and not an account on the machine (an OS login is a separate concept, not built). The target is identity_core's human, the one person every system's account also resolves to, so a device and an account meet on the same node; computing_core depends on identity_core for that type and nothing else. The edge is an assertion drawn by whoever knows the assignment (an operator's seed, an inventory or MDM feed) and never inferred from a display name or a hostname. A host with no edge is unassigned, which is itself what a device review looks for. Cardinality is not constrained: a shared kiosk or a pooled loaner is assigned to more than one person, and a person holds several hosts.

property_schema.description: Closed and empty: no source records anything about an assignment beyond the fact of it, so an edge of this type carries no properties.
